heat.actual_schema: Six columns; old wiki mentions four. Column 4 contains cue markers 37-42, NOT physical temperature. No rating column is used.
heat.alignment: Deposited time vector around stimulus trigger; no intensity-dependent ramp-up shift.
heat.units_caveat: MAT has no channel-unit field; voltage values treated as microvolts in line with BrainAmp export convention. This assumption affects amplitude QC and is explicitly disclosed.

shock.positive: PCollShock1-4: pain-related collision resulting in electrical shock
shock.negative: PCollNoShock1-4: same pain-associated cues, omitted shock
shock.alignment: Collision-event latency in both delivered and omitted cases; not cue onset.
shock.source_processing: Author average reference, 1-70 Hz filtering, 48-52 Hz stop filter, ICA/manual cleaning; already epoched. Not an equivalent raw preprocessing replication.
